verdict.rationale: An agency that publishes machine-readable datasets and electronic filing channels could plausibly ship official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no official SDK of any kind. The keyless data.texas.gov SODA endpoint is a host-platform (Socrata) query API, not a Comptroller SDK. EDI and approved third-party preparer software are filing channels, not developer SDKs, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.
